key_traits.label: Life cycle
key_traits.text: Annual in Flora of North America treatment.

key_traits.label: Leaf morphology
key_traits.text: Leaf blades orbiculate to broadly ovate or 3–7-lobed, usually 20–80 mm long, with a cordate base. Surfaces glabrous or sparsely pilose.

key_traits.label: Peduncle
key_traits.text: Generally glabrous; can bear one to several flowers.

key_traits.label: Sepals
key_traits.text: Short, usually about 6–7 mm long; narrowly elliptic-oblong, lanceolate, or oblong; apex acute to obtuse, often mucronulate-caudate; margins ciliate.

key_traits.label: Corolla
key_traits.text: Small lavender to pink/purple funnel-shaped corolla, usually about 10–20 mm long in Flora of North America.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Subglobose capsule; seed capsule view included in the curated photo set.

key_traits.label: Flowering
key_traits.text: Can flower over a long season in warm climates.
